phase: B1 stage 3b (the menu state's full record held in parts)
change: OriginalApplicationMenuSession.State.init holds the 0xc3a8-byte full record in parts at partStarts [0, 0xb440, 0xb580, 0xb588, 0xb8a8, 0xb8b0, 0xbb00, 0xc2d8] (globals, outer local, loop counter, saved playback, replay alias, rest of the outer block, World, tail). Every production slice and replace of full is one part or lies inside one, so the per-tick and per-iteration slices and replaces (bindings read/store: globals, World, saved playback, replay alias; the menu iteration's counter write and alias merge; validateAliases) share or install buffers instead of copying ~100 KB; store installs match.globals as part 0 and read slices it back shared. Whole reads of a parted record (bytes, defined, readOnce, flattened, == across layouts) are counted by OriginalStateRecord.partAssemblies, reported in the runtime's progress events and by android_speed.py (partAssembliesPerTick). Review fixes: the part caches share one lock (a copy allocates none), the range accessors trap like a flat record, the paged accessor is read-only.
